MovedNotice.title: We've moved!
MovedNotice.body: Badminton Meetup has a new address. The icon on your home screen points to the old one and will stop updating. Please reinstall from the new address (30 seconds) — everything is tied to your account, nothing is lost.
MovedNotice.iosCopyHint: iPhone can't install from here: copy, open Safari, paste → Share → Add to Home Screen.
MovedNotice.openLink: Or open it here first (shows instructions)
